Modulation of cutaneous wound healing by Losartan: A focus on MCP-1 activity and collagen synthesis. Losartan, a selective angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) antagonist, has shown anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic properties that may accelerate wound healing when applied topically. Impaired wound healing remains a global health concern, leading to chronic wounds, infection, and excessive scarring.
